  SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.amount_cents - COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS net_cents

GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY c.id;

WITH ranked_attempts AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    task_id,
    status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY task_id
      ORDER BY finished_at DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM attempts
), active_stats AS (
  SELECT
    t.project_id,
    COUNT(t.id) AS active_task_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ra.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_latest_count
  FROM tasks AS t
  LEFT JOIN ranked_attempts AS ra
    ON ra.task_id = t.id
   AND ra.rn = 1
  WHERE t.archived = 0
  GROUP BY t.project_id
)
